id: kebab-case-slug (unique; stable join key for comments & ratings)
title: Verbatim title of the resource
type: dataset | atlas-hub | tool-software | model | publication | media | contact
url: https://… (primary link; empty string if none, then note it)
source: Provider / journal / hosting body — NOT the platform
description: 1–2 factual sentences: what it is and why it matters. No invented numbers.
date: YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD (publication/release; empty if ongoing/unknown)
organisations: author affiliations / host — excluding anything equal to source

lead_contact.name: first or corresponding author (never last author)

data_availability: Open data | Open (with code) | Code only | On request | No associated data
reusable: true ONLY for a permissive licence (compute from licence)
ongoing: true for living resources (portals, dashboards, recurring feeds)
